method.scale: Signal-to-Spend is 0 to 100, spend-weighted. Green 80+, Amber 55 to 79, Red under 55.
method.states: Live 100, Weak 50, Dark 0, Redundant 0 and priced once at the lower instance.
method.evidence: Tier 1 direct read-only connector telemetry, Tier 2 CRM-side fingerprints, Tier 3 client-supplied admin export. Dark requires Tier 1 or Tier 2. Tier 3 alone can only support Weak.
method.notice: Every auto-renewing contract has a notice deadline, which is the renewal date minus the notice period written into the agreement. That deadline, not the renewal date, is the last day a cancellation can be served.
method.access: Read-only throughout. No call recordings, no deal history, no personally identifiable data, and no write permission to any system.
